title: Posts and the timeline — share a Torah thought, anchored to a source, and read what the people you follow share

tasks.title: Social schema and migration, posts and timeline API, query parameters for contracts, deletion coverage
The home page, composer, timeline, post page and the shared interface kit

acs.text: WHEN a signed-in viewer calls `POST /api/v1/posts` with `{body}` (1–2,000 characters after trimming), optionally `ref` (a source citation such as "Genesis 1:1", at most 200 characters) and optionally `asProfileId` (an institution profile the viewer administers, spec 025) THE SYSTEM SHALL store the post with its author profile (the viewer's own profile when `asProfileId` is absent) and answer 201 with the post as the timeline shows it; an empty or too-long body or ref answers 400 `request.invalid`, and an `asProfileId` the viewer does not administer answers 403 `post.forbidden`.
scenarios: AC-001 a learner posts a Torah thought anchored to a source

scenarios: AC-002 the timeline shows followed profiles' posts and the viewer's own, newest first, in pages

acs.text: WHEN a signed-in viewer calls `GET /api/v1/posts/{postId}` THE SYSTEM SHALL answer 200 with the post and its replies (spec 024), oldest reply first; an unknown or deleted post answers 404 `post.not_found`. WHEN the post's author (or an administrator of its institution profile) calls `DELETE /api/v1/posts/{postId}` THE SYSTEM SHALL mark it deleted and answer 204; anyone else answers 403 `post.forbidden`.
scenarios: AC-003 one post with its replies, and deleting it

acs.text: WHEN a signed-in viewer opens `/social` THE SYSTEM SHALL show, beside the rooms of spec 015, a composer and a timeline with two tabs, "Following" (the default) and "Everyone": the composer has a text area with a placeholder that invites a Torah thought, an optional source field that is pre-filled with the reader's current source when there is one, a character count that turns to a warning near the limit, and one primary "Post" button disabled while the text is empty; a new post appears at the top of the timeline at once; the timeline loads older posts with a "Show more" button, shows skeleton rows while loading, and an empty state with an invitation to follow people or post when there is nothing to show.
scenarios: AC-004 the composer and the timeline on /social

acs.text: WHEN a post has a source THE SYSTEM SHALL show the source's citation as a link that opens it in the reader (`host.navigate`, R15) and the source's opening text beneath the post body (the source-text renderer of spec 017); WHEN a viewer opens `/social/p/$postId` THE SYSTEM SHALL show that post on its own page with its author, time, body, source and actions, an author's "Delete" action that asks for confirmation first, and social's not-found page for an unknown id.
scenarios: AC-005 a post's source and its own page

acs.text: Every string the timeline, composer and post page add is in the interface language with matching `lang` and `dir`; post bodies keep their own direction (`dir="auto"`); times are relative ("5 min", "2 h", "3 Nov") in the interface language with the full date in the `<time>` element's `datetime` and title; every control is reachable by keyboard with a visible focus ring, and the timeline is a list of `<article>` elements.
scenarios: AC-006 language, direction, time and keyboard
